reviews.title: great resolution
reviews.comment: This monitor has great resolution and some arrived defective but the seller allowed exchanges at no additional cost which is convenient. We ordered 141 of these for Engineers. The only quirky thing is to attach them to a standing desk, the holes to mount them are not in the middle of the monitor making it difficult to put on arms for a standing desk because they are then top heavy.
reviews.author: Nicki Lee Kramer

reviews.title: Great purchase for the price
reviews.comment: Great size for gaming. Great picture!
reviews.author: Colleen McCaffery

reviews.title: Decent basic monitor
reviews.comment: It works well for a budget external monitor. Pros: the screen is large, diagonally is 27.5” and overall pretty decent quality. Connects easily. Cons: The built in speakers.. not great. There is absolutely no base to them so they sound blown out.
reviews.author: ashley

reviews.title: super happy with the deal!
reviews.comment: I have been on 27" monitor for years now and it took a day or so for my eyes to get used to curves. This monitor is so easy on the eyes and looks amazing. Has LED lights on the back which I don't use but a cool feature. It was easy to put together but just be careful as it seems fairly lightweight so take care when getting it in place. Its a game changer on looks and appeal and I am super happy with the deal!
reviews.author: Rob Nolfe
